login.title: Cashier sign-in
login.subtitle: Use your Echo Grid staff account. This device gets its own cashier session.
login.deviceLabelHint: For example, Counter 1. Your manager sees it in the session list.

errors.credentials: That email or password is not correct.
errors.access: This account cannot use the cashier app. Ask your manager for access.
errors.expired: This sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a moment.

login.chooseHint: Choose the business and branch for this device.

redeem.title: Redeem a reward code
redeem.subtitle: Type the code the customer shows, check what it is for, then confirm.

account.title: This device
account.signOutHint: Ends only this cashier session. Your other devices and the business dashboard stay signed in.

install.title: Install the cashier app
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.installed: The cashier app is installed on this device.
install.manual: If there is no Install button above, your browser has not offered one yet. In Chrome or Edge open the browser menu and choose Install app (or Add to Home screen).

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Customer lookups, purchases and redemptions need a connection. Nothing is saved offline. Reconnect to continue.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The cashier app could not load this screen. Your session is safe. Try again.

dashboard.title: Cashier app
dashboard.subtitle: A focused counter app for serving customers on a phone or tablet, with its own sign-in.
dashboard.unavailable: The cashier app is not available yet for this environment. Your owner or platform administrator will let you know when it is.
dashboard.access: Your role gives you access to the cashier app. Sign in there with your normal staff email and password.
dashboard.noAccess: Your role does not include serving customers, so the cashier app is not available to you.
dashboard.installIntro: Open the cashier app on the counter device, then install it so it opens like an app.

steps.android: Android (Chrome): open the cashier app, then tap the menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
steps.ios: iPhone and iPad (Safari): open the cashier app, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
steps.desktop: Computer (Chrome or Edge): open the cashier app and click the install icon in the address bar.

dashboard.unsupportedNote: If your browser cannot install apps, the cashier app still works in a normal browser tab.
dashboard.ownerNote: As an owner you can use and install the cashier app without any extra setup or approval.

sessions.title: Active cashier sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices currently signed in to the cashier app for this business.
sessions.confirmAll: Sign out every cashier device for this business? Staff will need to sign in again.
sessions.failed: Could not sign the device out. Try again.

activity.title: Cashier activity
activity.subtitle: What happened at the counter: lookups, QR checks, points, redemptions and device sessions.

actions.cashier_session_revoked: Cashier device signed out by manager

activity.empty: No cashier activity matches these filters.
activity.noAccess: Your role cannot view cashier activity. Ask the business owner or an administrator.
activity.branchRequired: Choose a branch to view its activity.
